slice.title: Add suppliers to the product catalog
slice.goal: Extend the adjusted-stock products-app prototype with a second Supplier resource and product-to-supplier selection/filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product catalog create, edit, list, search, category filter, stock quantity, availability filter, Adjust Stock action, and availability label behavior remains working.
User can create a supplier with name and contact email inside the product catalog prototype.
User can select a supplier when creating a product.
User can change a product supplier when editing a product.
Product list displays the selected supplier name.
User can filter the product list by supplier.
The run adds suppliers as a second resource without replacing the existing products resource.
constraints: Use --from-run with a successful adjusted-stock products-app run as baseline, for example runs/run-007-products-adjust-stock.
Preserve existing /api/products route and root ProductCatalogScreen.
Preserve existing product search, category filter, stock_quantity create/edit, availability filter, Adjust Stock action, and availability label behavior.
Add supplier support through small, focused changes and new supplier-owned files where appropriate.
Prefer a single coherent product catalog UI over a separate unrelated supplier application.
No delete product behavior and no delete supplier behavior unless explicitly required by the approved plan.
No purchase orders, contracts, supplier scoring, procurement workflow, authentication, external systems, or database migrations.
Continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Purchase order or inventory procurement workflow.
External integrations or persistent database migrations.
Reworking the product catalog into a different navigation model.
notes: This scenario validates an incremental structural extension: adding a second resource to an already extended generated prototype.
The baseline should be a successful run of samples/products-app-adjust-stock, for example runs/run-007-products-adjust-stock.
This is an incremental scenario, not a greenfield product catalog.
Use it after a successful products-app-adjust-stock run to verify that the pipeline can add a second resource while preserving previous product behavior.
